quest.title: Antigonus
quest.description: You discover a certain story within the hanging prison, and you go in search of...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x300, Primogem x40, Hero's Wit x4, Mora x30000

talks.objective: Talk to the afterimage in prison

dialogues.text: Are you the Jibashiri they've sent to release us?
Nah, you're too young, must be an apprentice or something.

Pfah, but you know what? I'm not shocked. I'll bet those high-and-mighty Jibashiri couldn't stand the loss of face from accusing three innocent people, so they sent some youngster down to do their dirty work and apologize in their stead. Isn't that right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are you the people who've been suspected of stealing "Before Sun and Moon"?

dialogues.speaker: Oogura
dialogues.text: What "suspect"? The name's Oogura, and we were falsely accused, alright?

dialogues.speaker: Oogura
dialogues.text: But never mind that. You're not here to let us out, are you? Well, if not that, I suppose you're after that guy?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "That guy"?

dialogues.speaker: Oogura
dialogues.text: The third guy! I don't know him well, but the fellow next to me does — just a bit, but it counts! Go on, ask him.

dialogues.speaker: Oogura
dialogues.text: The guy who escaped is a rather fierce character. But I can guarantee that he, like the two of us here, is innocent.

dialogues.speaker: Oogura
dialogues.text: I mean, come on, it's Enkanomiya's last day. Let's not endanger human lives now, shall we?

talks.objective: Talk to the afterimage in prison

dialogues.text: Forget the book, forget whether we were falsely accused or not. Go find Antei!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Antei?

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima
dialogues.text: Yes, he's the third guy who was locked up together with us. I'm Ooshima, and as for that guy, his name's Antigonus, or Antei, if you want the Narukami Island-ized version.

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima
dialogues.text: He was an apprentice Jibashiri as well. Fierce temper, and super strong to boot. He escaped by grabbing the tiny bumps in the cliff and climbing right out of here.

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima
dialogues.text: That's just horrifying. Is that even possible for normal people?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Actually, I can do that too.

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima
dialogues.text: Ugh, forget it. You people who volunteer to become Jibashiri, I bet you've trained so hard that you've ceased to be human anymore.

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima
dialogues.text: I've heard that the test to become a Jibashiri involves the candidate lifting one foot with both hands and standing in a circle.

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima
dialogues.text: Then they get 12 other Jibashiri to stab at them with spears, and if they can go an entire night without being injured, they pass.

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima
dialogues.text: I mean, you're a Jibashiri candidate. Is that rumor true?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not as far as I know...

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima
dialogues.text: Seriously? Are you telling me that it's even worse?

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima
dialogues.text: C'mon, tell me!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Isn't the issue with Antei more important?

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima
dialogues.text: Oh... Right. Yeah. *cough*

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima
dialogues.text: He said that he would leave us a picture of a "byrde" as a sign to mark his path.

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima
dialogues.text: It's an animal you can't find here in Enkanomiya. It can fly, it has wings, and it symbolizes freedom. Or something.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Isn't that a "bird"?

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima
dialogues.text: Right. That's right. "Bird."

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima
dialogues.text: He told me his plan was to climb up, retrieve a set of official-issue exploration gear that he'd hidden there beforehand, and then set off in the direction of the Serpent's Heart. Said he was following some leads about a delegation from Khaenri'ah.

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima
dialogues.text: He said that he'd prove our innocence, even if that was the last thing he did, and that if any officials or shrine maidens came to look for us, we should tell them that he was headed for the Serpent's Heart.

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima
dialogues.text: So yeah, even if he doesn't make it, he'll leave a bird picture behind as a clue to lead people to the proof that we're innocent.

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima
dialogues.text: As long as nothing goes wrong, you should be able to find him by following the bird pictures.

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima
dialogues.text: Our lives are at stake here, so please, go!

dialogues.speaker: Antei
dialogues.text: I once heard a Narukami Island envoy talk about this creature named a "bird." It has wings and it can fly through the skies.

dialogues.speaker: Antei
dialogues.text: That's just amazing, can you imagine it?

dialogues.speaker: Antei
dialogues.text: Some people believe that they are messengers from the gods who carry word of human fates.

dialogues.speaker: Antei
dialogues.text: And if some exiled person finally expires out in the wild, the very same creature will come to peck and consume their mortal flesh.

dialogues.speaker: Antei
dialogues.text: These animals fascinate me, to be honest. If I should see the light of another day, I will definitely keep a bird.
You two are...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are you Antei?

dialogues.speaker: Antei
dialogues.text: That's right. That's me. I feel... a little strange...

dialogues.speaker: Antei
dialogues.text: I remember chasing those scoundrels... ripping a core out and throwing it into a camp. Then after that, I got a little woozy from my own injuries... I was hurt pretty bad...

dialogues.speaker: Antei
dialogues.text: But then I woke up, and then I met you, and now I feel fine. Tell me, am I going to die soon or something?

dialogues.speaker: Antei
dialogues.text: ...No, that's not important right now. Are you here to arrest me again? I've already proven my innocence.

dialogues.speaker: Antei
dialogues.text: It was those people from Khaenri'ah. They were the ones who stole that library book. I was assigned as one of their bodyguards, sure, but there's no way I would have been in cahoots with them!

dialogues.speaker: Antei
dialogues.text: I tracked their diplomatic team to this place and beat them all.

dialogues.speaker: Antei
dialogues.text: But I spent a long time dealing with some giant mechanical creature they had with them. Finally, I was able to tear its core out, but I was wounded seriously in the process.

dialogues.speaker: Antei
dialogues.text: The disabled machine crashed on top of the lost book. There's no way to retrieve it now.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, Byakuyakoku's Jibashiri are pretty tough...

dialogues.speaker: Antei
dialogues.text: Wait, you aren't Jibashiri or candidates yourselves? *sigh* Whatever. The Jibashiri started out as heroes who fought against the Bathysmal Vishaps. It was only later that they became law enforcement — the judges of the nether.

dialogues.speaker: Antei
dialogues.text: The machine's core is in the camp. Go there and have a look if you don't believe me.

dialogues.speaker: Antei
dialogues.text: Did you get the book?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We did. You're indeed innocent, Antei.

dialogues.speaker: Antei
dialogues.text: From how you spoke earlier, you aren't Jibashiri... Which is a shame. You could've declared me innocent on the spot otherwise.

dialogues.speaker: Antei
dialogues.text: That would have saved me some time.

dialogues.speaker: Antei
dialogues.text: Again, I feel really energized, but I'm quite sure that I was exhausted from losing too much blood just a while ago. I just can't shake the feeling that I'm going to die shortly...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh...

dialogues.speaker: Antei
dialogues.text: *sigh* Let me ask you a question, stranger. Does a man sin who has been wrongly convicted by Byakuyakoku?

dialogues.speaker: Antei
dialogues.text: If I, due to my disturbed state of mind, was left here by Tokoyo Ookami as a Sinshade. Is this transgression?

dialogues.speaker: Antei
dialogues.text: Am I guilty?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No, you aren't.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Be careful {NICKNAME}. If he realizes that... you know, then he's gonna disappear.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're just an afterimage that Antei left behind.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You are innocent, and I will make sure the world knows that.

dialogues.speaker: Antei
dialogues.text: Haha. So that's it? So, I'm just a shadow, left behind after my death.

dialogues.speaker: Antei
dialogues.text: And... I am innocent.
